name: Structure-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (SAGS)
definition: A structure-aware Gaussian Splatting method that implicitly encodes the geometry of the scene using a local-global graph representation to facilitate learning complex scenes and enforce meaningful point displacements that preserve the scene's geometry, reducing floating points and artifacts.
summary: Structure-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting is a novel-view synthesis method that uses graph neural networks to encode scene geometry, reducing artifacts and memory usage while capturing high-frequency details.
